name: d3rac-tron-contracts
description: TronBox project for D3R-AC's TRON contracts (D3RACToken, IdentityRegistry, DisbursementController, MultiSigAdmin, D3RACHub, RiskRegistry, FundingRequestRegistry). This package.json is for TronBox only (see tronbox-config.js) -- it stays plain CommonJS deliberately. The Hardhat logic-test harness lives in ./hardhat, as its own nested package with its own package.json ('type': 'module'), so the two tools' conflicting module-type requirements never collide in one package.json. See ./hardhat/hardhat.config.js and docs/deployment-guide.md for actual TRON deployment.
